text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaargghhh―!! I, I've… What a mess I've 
made of this run!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That was ab-so-lutely not! By any means! 
an exemplary run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That was the run of a flunk-student! Now, 
I'm Bakushin-ing down the road to becoming 
a delinqueeeent―!!

Can you recover from failure? That's the 
real key to success, I told her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
…So, in other words, what you're saying 
is, I'm still Bakushin-ing down the 
glorious honor student road at this very 
moment!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I seeee! ……I won't let this happen again! 
Let's start training straightaway!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I have to set an example for everyone! 
There's no time to stand still!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
choice_data_list:
You're supposed to be a role model for 
everyone, right?

You're supposed to be a role model for 
everyone, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
…Yes, I have not yet resigned from my 
position as class president……!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In order to carry out my solemn duty of 
guiding each and every Uma Musume, I must 
keep going with everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A model student from cradle to grave!! 
Because that's exactly what Sakura 
Bakushin O is!
